responsibility: This header is the central public interface for the gcc/lto module. It defines the basic lto_file and lto_section data structures and declares the module-wide entry points for LTO execution, EH personality selection, option masking, object-file section reading/writing, current-output-file tracking, and dump identifiers, allowing the front end, streamer, and object back end to share the same LTO abstractions.
same_name_distinction: This header is the shared interface/abstraction layer for the module, defining core types like lto_file and lto_section_slot and declaring module-wide APIs. Unlike gcc/lto/lto.cc, it does not drive LTO execution modes or orchestrate WPA/LTRANS processing.
